newsitem.title: JAPAN: Riso Kagaku shares rise to 1997 high.
newsitem.headline: Riso Kagaku shares rise to 1997 high.

text.p: Shares of Riso Kagaku Corp rose to a record high for the calendar year on Wednesday, helped by buying from foreign investors who focused on the firm's strong profitability, traders said.
The share price of the printing machine producer briefly touched 9,010 yen, the highest level so far this year. At 0528 GMT, it was up 270 yen at 9,000. Volume was 56,100 shares.

"There has been buying to hunt for winners in the over-the-counter (OTC) market. Foreign investors in particular seemed to keep on buying the shares," said an OTC trader at a second-tier Japanese securities house.
